restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมแฮฟฟัน
text: Today I had an emergency. My tooth broke in half 8 years ago, but it wasn't convenient to get a crown at the time 🤣🤣🤣. Today it fell out, leaving me with a gap. I had to quickly find a clinic near my house. I found this place, called, and the staff let me talk to the dentist first. When I went in, the dentist recommended a crown, as is standard practice, but I wasn't comfortable with that, so I asked if I could have a filling done like before. The dentist quoted 1500-2000 baht, which I agreed to. The dentist was very meticulous and dedicated, taking a long time. My tooth looks even better than the last one! The price was also cheap, and they even included a teeth cleaning using my social security insurance. Usually, other places charge extra, but not here! Hahaha! The dentist's name was Kao, if I remember correctly.
